label: PF Backlog 564
title: Hygiene: pre-commit regenerates derived docs when data/backlog changes (docs-fresh staleness on bookkeeping commits)
body:
## Problem / why
A bookkeeping-only commit on `develop` (stages only `data/backlog/**`) leaves the DERIVED docs
(`docs/BACKLOG-SUMMARY.md`, `docs/documentation-index.html`) stale. Because bookkeeping commits are allowed
directly on `develop` (branch_guard) and bypass `precheck`, the staleness only surfaces on the NEXT PR's CI
as `docs-fresh` FAIL. (Observed on PR #27: BI-PF-1245 record -> stale BACKLOG-SUMMARY -> docs-fresh fail.)

## 5-Why (RCCA)
1. The next PR's CI failed `docs-fresh`.
2. `BACKLOG-SUMMARY.md` did not reflect the just-recorded backlog item.
3. Derived docs are regenerated only at `precheck` (merge/CI), not at commit time.
4. Bookkeeping-only commits on `develop` bypass `precheck`.
ROOT CAUSE: derived-artifact regeneration is enforced at merge/CI, not at the commit boundary where the
backlog actually changes.

## Corrective
The `pre-commit` hook regenerates the derived docs when `data/backlog/**` is staged and stages the neutral
derived docs (BACKLOG-SUMMARY.md, documentation-index.html), so every backlog change keeps them fresh. The
two files are already in branch_guard's `_NEUTRAL` set, so a bookkeeping-only commit on `develop` stays allowed.

## Guard
The hook step (this item) + `docs-fresh` (already in precheck). Together: derived docs cannot be stale at
commit time.

## Acceptance criteria (G/W/T)
- Given a staged change under `data/backlog/**`, when `git commit` runs, then the derived docs are
  regenerated + staged, and `docs-fresh` passes on the committed tree.
- Given no backlog change, then the hook does nothing (no churn).

## Related (by id)
BI-PF-0258 (auto-refresh generated docs - incomplete coverage), BI-PF-1232 (CI4), BI-PF-1244 (script drift).
